<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" targetNamespace="http://www.blizzard.com/bpmn/character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterGenerator" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" name="Start character creation">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Start two activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_Names</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_To_BnetCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ComeUpWithNames" name="Come up with character names">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_Names</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Names_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasBattlenetAccount" name="Has battle.net account?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_To_BnetCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoBnet_To_EnterAccount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasBnet_To_BnetMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterAccountInfo" name="Enter account information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoBnet_To_EnterAccount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterAccount_To_ConfirmLink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click confirmation link in mail">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterAccount_To_ConfirmLink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ConfirmLink_To_BnetMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetMerge" name="Battle.net account available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasBnet_To_BnetMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ConfirmLink_To_BnetMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BnetMerge_To_SubCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HasSubscription" name="Has active WoW subscription?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BnetMerge_To_SubCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoSub_To_SelectPayment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HasSub_To_SubMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoSub_To_SelectPayment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectPayment_To_PaymentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod" name="Payment method?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectPayment_To_PaymentSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_To_CreditCard</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_To_Iban</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCreditCard" name="Enter credit card information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_To_CreditCard</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreditCard_To_SubMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterIbanBic" name="Enter IBAN and BIC numbers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_To_Iban</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Iban_To_SubMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SubMerge" name="Subscription active">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HasSub_To_SubMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreditCard_To_SubMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Iban_To_SubMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubMerge_To_LogIn</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into the game">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubMerge_To_LogIn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LogIn_To_SelectRealm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass" name="Select realm, race and class">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LogIn_To_SelectRealm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectRealm_To_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Join" name="Names prepared and character settings selected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Names_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectRealm_To_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_To_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter character name">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_To_EnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameTaken_To_EnterName</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterName_To_AvailableCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Name still available?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterName_To_AvailableCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameTaken_To_EnterName</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NameAvailable_To_Confirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation and character selfies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NameAvailable_To_Confirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_To_ExpansionEvent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_To_ExpansionEvent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExpansionEvent_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ExpansionReleased" messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExpansionNotified" name="Expansion message received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExpansionEvent_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreateCharacter" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Names" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_BnetCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Gateway_HasBattlenetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Names_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoBnet_To_EnterAccount" sourceRef="Gateway_HasBattlenetAccount" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasBattlenetAccount == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasBnet_To_BnetMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_HasBattlenetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BnetMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasBattlenetAccount == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAccount_To_ConfirmLink" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmLink_To_BnetMerge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_BnetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetMerge_To_SubCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetMerge" targetRef="Gateway_HasSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSub_To_SelectPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_HasSubscription" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasActiveSubscription == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HasSub_To_SubMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_HasSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_SubMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasActiveSubscription == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectPayment_To_PaymentSplit" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_To_CreditCard" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCard">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentMethod == 'creditCard'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_To_Iban" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod" targetRef="Task_EnterIbanBic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentMethod == 'bankAccount'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_To_SubMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCard" targetRef="Gateway_SubMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Iban_To_SubMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterIbanBic" targetRef="Gateway_SubMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubMerge_To_LogIn" sourceRef="Gateway_SubMerge" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LogIn_To_SelectRealm" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectRealm_To_Join" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealmRaceClass" targetRef="Gateway_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_To_EnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_Join" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_To_AvailableCheck" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameTaken_To_EnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nameAvailable == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_To_Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nameAvailable == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_To_ExpansionEvent" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleased"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionEvent_To_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleased" targetRef="EndEvent_ExpansionNotified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
